name: Summit AZ - Early Post-Redesign Snapshot 2026-09-10
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-09-10

# Summary
A locked, preliminary read of the first 7 days after the Sep 3 relaunch (Sep 4 to 10) against the matching 7 days before (Aug 28 to Sep 3). Captured read-only Sep 11. Seven days is too short for firm conclusions.

# Bottom line
1. GA4 stopped measuring on launch day: the launch switched the Google tag to a different GA4 property, so 459518259 showed zero sessions from Sep 4 (fixed by Scott Sep 12).
2. The launch was a full database replacement, not a restyle: every local page got a new WordPress record at the same URL, SEO moved from MetaSync/OTTO to Rank Math, and the menu, lead form, tag and six general plumbing city pages changed.
3. Search visibility was mixed and within noise: impressions +15.7% (2,397 to 2,774), clicks 5 to 12, CTR 0.21% to 0.43%, but average position slipped 23.6 to 30.7; queries with impressions rose 321 to 545.
4. Biggest risk: 1,993 OTTO fixes still marked deployed. Switching the pixel on would push all of them live at once, including 24/7 schema, fake review markup, "$20 off" offers, competitor names and headings replacing tracking phones.

# Caveats
- At least 2 clicks came from the Philippines (likely TAG staff checking pages). Sep 9 and 10 were still filling in.
- TAG made large post-launch edits inside the window (titles Sep 5; design, H1, link and noindex fixes Sep 9 to 10). The OTTO pixel was live for about an hour on Sep 4 to 5.
- Segments: branded 3 to 4 clicks; non-branded impressions 1,474 to 2,014; "near me" 86 to 220.
